text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. Under the blazing 
sun, Biwa Hayahide continued her distance 
running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Beach sprints, ten sets, 
complete. Next menu... please.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Unnecessary. I made sure to hydrate 
sufficiently before starting the dash.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Let's increase the load further. And 
while we're at it, I want you to measure 
the exact figures.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's also to calculate just how much my 
body can withstand, and how much further 
it can grow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide seems completely serious. 
For her sake, what kind of training should 
I propose...?
choice_data_list: OK, time for scorching aerobics hell!!

OK, into the scorching aerobics hell we 
go!!
Wanna run an extra 40 km marathon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide seems completely serious. 
For her sake, what kind of training should 
I propose...?
choice_data_list: OK, time for scorching aerobics hell!!

OK, into the scorching aerobics hell we 
go!!
Wanna run an extra 40 km marathon?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Aerobics hell...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I connect the smartphone to the speakers I 
brought for Biwa Hayahide and start 
playing the music.

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai♪ Welcome, everyone, to Muscle 
Girl's HAPPY HELL Workout! Let's kick 
things off by raising one leg—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"Okay♪ Warm-up complete☆ Was that 
easy-peasy? Next up is upper-body 
exercise♪"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A-An hour has already passed, hasn't 
it...? This... is a 'light warm-up'...?!

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"Oopsie, don't forget to smile~☆ Shake 
that hip and muscle-muscle♪"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
K-Krrrghh!!?? What kind of training is 
thissss?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A marathon... In other words, rather than 
sprinting ability, we should first train 
whole-body muscle strength.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, 40 km. That's practically a full 
marathon. If we start running now... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll do it. I was the one who brought 
it up. Besides, if I shrink back at this 
level, I will never achieve the growth I 
desire.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I'll prove that I can surpass my own 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 40km marathon kicked off. 
Keeping a close eye on her condition—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And time went on...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...
choice_data_list: ...You really gave it everything you had.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed myself...! To think my basic 
stamina had grown enough to handle that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your dedication to training ever since 
that Derby has really paid off!
choice_data_list: It's because you worked so hard.
It's because you worked so hard

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't praise me so much. In 
truth, it was simply that my resolve was 
lacking before.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps I was continuously ignoring 
it. The choice to step beyond the limits I 
had set for myself."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Overtaken, out of reach, pushing myself 
too hard... Ever since that day I got 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet we have already advanced to the next 
phase! We can contemplate limitless 
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Was that line a little too cheesy just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see... Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...All that's left now is to deliver 
results at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Biwa Hayahide's vow, we left 
the beach under the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Meetup time is 8:00 AM tomorrow, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Their abilities are steadily improving. 
The results exceed expectations. All 
that's left is an actual race.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (And yet, all I can think about is...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DERBYYYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Satsuki Sho' and 'Japanese Derby' 
are still clinging to my mind.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ... Let's get something warm to drink and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“...Tomorrow, at 10:00. Face me in a 
straight dash showdown.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's give it everything we've got! 
I'm gonna win this!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I'm giving those exact words right 
back to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you scare me more than anyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to win the Kikuka Sho 
with all of you in it... I want to take 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. That's strange. There wasn't 
anything wrong with what Taishin said, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why is my heart rate increasing? ...Why, 
so much...?
